text_block_list.text: The day of the year-end Grand Prix, the Arima Kinen, has arrived—
—The paddock was enveloped in an extraordinary heat.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Ehehe, we're together again, Rob Roy-san!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yes... But, um...
It's not the 'same' as before... is it?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
...They are staring at us. Fuji, you haven't been
seducing our juniors again, have you?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, making me sound like a player. But
if that's the case, it's definitely your fault, not mine.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
“—Because someone as enchanting as you...
is the master of this room right now.”

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
...I think this every time, but
what is with your choice of words?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I'll take that as a compliment.
Still, to think you'd join such a fierce struggle once again.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Hmph. Don't go forcing retirement on people.
...I've simply been taking it easy as of late.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Did you come here just to make your juniors cry?
Plotting a reign as long as some ancient French king?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: "I haven't calmed down completely yet either. And my reason is probably the same as yours."

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: —I just want to look cool every now and then.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: ...Hah.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"Once in a while? He's pretentious all the time.
I'll shut him up during the race, at least."

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
S-Spe and Rob Roy...
and Fuji Kiseki and Air Groove too?!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text: "Whoa, whoa, even for the Arima Kinen, isn't this line-up way too much of a dream match?!"

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
"First the Japan Cup, and now the Arima...
Why has it turned into such an insane spectacle...?!"

text_block_list.name: Spectators A & B
text_block_list.text: I-I'm looking forward to it sooooo muuuuch!

Ever since looking at the entry list,
Eishin Flash had been—

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
No problem.
Let's go, Trainer.
—It burned with a quiet flame.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Another wall to overcome has appeared.
That is all...
choice_data_list: Let's fire ourselves up even more than usual!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Natürlich—of course.
A demanding race is precisely what makes it worth challenging.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: All of it, so that I can become someone truly proud...!
